notes: No cumulative file or directory candidate cap, no top-k candidate truncation.
Hierarchy virtual grouping width is 32; all children retained. Summary samples do not cap candidates.
Lexical rescue: two informative query tokens, or a token present in <=2% of paths; a single-token query retains every exact match.
Final selection uses the same >=0.65 OR top-1%-with-ties rule as V1, applied after scoring, not as a candidate cap.
Transport max_candidate_bytes=48000 is a batch payload partition, not a logical candidate budget.
Cold arms have independent calls; quality arms share exact semantic batch responses. Do not compare cached wall time as standalone latency.
First-repeat diagnostic; further repeats chosen after inspecting algorithmic failure modes. No stability claims.
Same-directory neighbor closure is the first metadata-only relation ablation; learned relations and calibrated stopping remain future work.
